meta.name: hunt-sharepoint
meta.description: Hunt Microsoft SharePoint Server (2013/2016/2019/Subscription Edition) on-prem farms — anonymous endpoint enumeration, version disclosure, legacy SOAP login bypass (Authentication.asmx), ToolShell precondition chain (CVE-2025-53770), SafeControl reflection enumeration via Picker.aspx, NTLM Type-2 AD topology disclosure, custom-branding module discovery, EoL farm permanent-CVE-window exploitation, FormDigest anonymous issuance, file-extension blocklist NOT-an-oracle pattern, custom-zone Forms auth bridging on-prem AD. Use when target has SharePoint headers (SPRequestGuid, X-MS-InvokeApp, X-SharePointHealthScore, MicrosoftSharePointTeamServices) or paths (/_layouts/15/, /_vti_bin/, /_api/, /_catalogs/).

copy.tagline: 探测 SharePoint 服务器的安全漏洞与配置弱点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对 SharePoint 服务器进行安全审计或渗透测试。
copy.tagline_en: Probe SharePoint servers for security vulnerabilities and misconfigurations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to audit or pentest SharePoint servers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描 SharePoint 服务器，发现版本、匿名接口、旧版 SOAP 登录绕过、ToolShell 漏洞、NTLM 信息泄露等安全问题。
howto.when: 当目标网站响应头包含 SPRequestGuid、X-MS-InvokeApp 等 SharePoint 特征，或路径包含 /_layouts/15/、/_vti_bin/ 等时触发。

say.text: 扫描这个 SharePoint 服务器，看看有哪些匿名接口。
say.note: Claude 会枚举所有可匿名访问的端点。

say.text: 检查这个 SharePoint 的版本和已知漏洞。
测试 Authentication.asmx 是否可匿名暴力破解。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will scan SharePoint servers to discover version, anonymous endpoints, legacy SOAP login bypass, ToolShell vulnerability, NTLM info disclosure, and other security issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when target response headers contain SharePoint indicators like SPRequestGuid, X-MS-InvokeApp, or paths like /_layouts/15/, /_vti_bin/.

say_en.text: Scan this SharePoint server for anonymous endpoints.
say_en.note: Claude will enumerate all anonymously accessible endpoints.

say_en.text: Check this SharePoint version and known vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve version via multiple methods and map to CVE list.

say_en.text: Test if Authentication.asmx is anonymously brute-forceable.
say_en.note: Claude will send SOAP requests to confirm auth mode and check rate limits.
